verdict.rationale: Formant documents event-triggered webhooks that call any HTTP endpoint when a Formant event fires, and markets automated incident response, monitoring workflows, and fleet orchestration that assigns jobs and dispatches help on its own. Its AI-driven task recommendations, however, are explicitly gated by human approval, and the autonomous-automation evidence is mostly marketing-level. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring scheduled or rule-based background automations, evidence of AI/agent-driven automations running without human approval, independent or hands-on corroboration.
